studies.label: S1 — Metabolic partnership: can an archaeal-bacterial pair gain fitness from exchange?
S2 — Ecology to proximity: when does cross-feeding select for persistent contact?
S3 — Protrusions to enclosure: can protrusion mechanics reach stable wrapping?
S4 — Compartmental energetic coupling: does internalization pay for itself?
S5 — From symbiont to organelle: when does integration become heritable?

nodes.label: Calibrated (p_diacid=1e-8, p_monoacid=1e-7, k_wash=0.01, 250 steps): the conn...
nodes.statement: Calibrated (p_diacid=1e-8, p_monoacid=1e-7, k_wash=0.01, 250 steps): the connected cross-feeding community settles to metacommunity_robustness 0.536 (> 0.5, PASS) while the isolated control (coupling=private) settles to 0.464 (< 0.5, FAIL) — a partner-dependent advantage of 1.15 (connected/isolated). Carbon mass balance holds (worst-case residual 5.6e-11). Establishes a mechanistically plausible route (connected community) and a well-characterized failure route (isolated control) at first fidelity. Computed via a direct in-process composite run; the tracked workbench run awaits the evaluator reaching the genesis venv.

nodes.label: The isolated no-exchange control (coupling=private) settles to metacommunity_...
nodes.statement: The isolated no-exchange control (coupling=private) settles to metacommunity_robustness 0.464 (< 0.5) — without reciprocal exchange the community does not develop functional redundancy. The partner-dependent advantage (connected 0.536 vs isolated 0.464) is the discriminating signal.

nodes.label: Calibrated (k_diffusion=0.001, 250 steps): proximate (mixed) partners sustain...
nodes.statement: Calibrated (k_diffusion=0.001, 250 steps): proximate (mixed) partners sustain cross-lineage flux 4.0e-22 mol/tick while distant (segregated) partners sustain only 1.8e-23 — a 22x proximity advantage, so selection favours persistent contact. The advantage is diffusion- dependent: at k_diffusion=0.1 the mixed/segregated ratio is 1.26 (proximity barely matters, diffusion carries the intermediate). Establishes that proximity selection is a spatial- structure effect, not a given — a precondition for intimate symbiosis. Direct in-process run.

nodes.label: At low diffusion the distant (segregated) partners sustain cross-lineage flux...
nodes.statement: At low diffusion the distant (segregated) partners sustain cross-lineage flux of only 1.821e-23 — an order of magnitude below the proximate 4.005e-22 (the 22x advantage). Distance breaks the exchange, so persistent contact is selected only where spatial structure holds.

nodes.label: Enclosure is topology-gated, not a settled yes. The higher-fidelity active-pr...
nodes.statement: Enclosure is topology-gated, not a settled yes. The higher-fidelity active-protrusion membrane-wrapping model (Helfrich bending + adhesion + tension + finite protrusion area + active force F*R, 3D; the mechanism the question is about) supersedes the coarser arms: classical EXTERNAL engulfment reaches a stable wrap for only a MINORITY of partners (probability 0.27, a narrow 0.41-0.56 um window), with the active protrusion load-bearing (raises it from 0.17; 36% of enclosures need the force); INSIDE-OUT invagination (Baum & Baum) is far more feasible (0.83). The coarse arms overstated it — the 2D passive-adhesion CPM read 1.00 (but that is regime-assumed, J_hs < J_sM-J_hM, with no protrusion) and the static area+bending budget read 0.61/0.98. So whether the enclosure hypothesis is supported depends on which topology is primary, which remains an open investigation decision. Enclosure is a separate hurdle from metabolic benefit; morphology alone does not demonstrate engulfment.

nodes.label: Calibrated (60 steps, declining external gradient): with an efficient pump (c...
nodes.statement: Calibrated (60 steps, declining external gradient): with an efficient pump (catalyst_efficiency=1.0) the population internalizes gradient generation and survives (survivors 1.00, autonomy 0.99, fitness 0.68) — internalization is net-positive. The weak-pump control (catalyst_efficiency=0.3) collapses (survivors 0.00, fitness 0.059) — a well-characterized harmful regime where internalization cannot pay the Sojo membrane cost. An enclosed partner develops organelle-like function only under restricted physiological conditions. Direct in-process run.

nodes.label: Calibrated (60 generations): a high-fidelity template lineage (per_site_fidel...
nodes.statement: Calibrated (60 generations): a high-fidelity template lineage (per_site_fidelity=0.99) reaches heritability 0.989 and persists with full function (population 220) — stable heritable integration, a new evolutionary individual. Two well-characterized failure routes: a low-fidelity template (0.80) hits the Eigen error catastrophe and collapses (heritability 0.799, population 0), and a non-heritable mechanism transmits nothing (heritability 0.106). Heritable integration emerges only above the fidelity threshold. Direct in-process run.

nodes.label: Below the fidelity threshold the lineage hits the Eigen error catastrophe: a ...
nodes.statement: Below the fidelity threshold the lineage hits the Eigen error catastrophe: a low-fidelity template (per_site_fidelity=0.30) collapses to heritability 0.0 — the inherited phenotype is lost. The catastrophe sits between per_site_fidelity 0.5 and 0.3 (sweep: 0.50 -> 0.592, 0.30 -> 0.0).
